description: Fetch the markdown companion documentation for one device, if present. The device is a catalogue id or an OSC prefix without the leading slash (e.g. 'ableton' for /ableton).

device.description: The driver id that list_devices gives (e.g. 'korg/minilogue_xd.pencilresearch'), or the device's short name (e.g. 'minilogue_xd'), which stands for its default driver.

user_id.description: Your anonymous SyntHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: get_device_docs

device.description: The id of the driver the docs are of.

has_docs.description: False when no companion .md exists for the device.

markdown.description: The companion documentation, or a not-found message when has_docs is false.
